restartTitle: Zabaan badalne ke liye restart karein?
restartBody: Text ki simt badalne ke liye Tally Stick ko restart karna hoga. Save kiye drafts rahen ge.
changeFailed: Zabaan badal nahin saki. Dobara koshish karein.
saveYourTallyStickData: Apna Tally Stick data save karein
theJsonFileIsInTheFolderYouChose: JSON file aap ke chune hue folder mein hai.
sharedChangesInvitationsFriendRequestsAn: Mushtarka tabdeeliyan, daawatein, friend requests aur reminders yahan aayen ge.
pushNotificationsRequireATallyStickBuild: Push notifications ke liye asli device par Expo se linked Tally Stick build chahiye.
allowNotificationsInYourDeviceSettingsTo: Push notifications ke liye device settings mein notifications ki ijazat dein.
everyDeviceWillBeSignedOut: Har device se sign out ho jayega
changingYourPasswordEndsEverySessionIncl: Password badalne se yeh aur tamam sessions khatam ho jayen ge. Aap sign in par wapas aayen ge.
atLeast12CharactersLongerBeatsComplicate: Kam az kam 12 characters. Mushkil se behtar lamba password hai.
theTwoNewPasswordsDoNotMatch: Dono naye passwords match nahin karte.
thisIsPermanentYourProfileIsAnonymizedAn: Yeh mustaqil hai. Profile ki pehchaan mita di jayegi aur har device se sign out hoga. Financial history audit ke liye rahe gi.
permanentlyDeleteAccount: Account hamesha ke liye delete karein
deletionReviewBalances: Aap ke kuch balance khule hain. Aage barhne ke liye unhein yahin settle karein.
deletionReviewGroups: Aap abhi bhi active groups mein hain. Un mein aap ke balance settle hain, is liye aap unhein yahin chhor sakte hain.
deletionReviewBoth: Aap ke khule balance aur active groups hain. Aage barhne ke liye unhein yahin settle karein aur chhorein.
recordedYouPaid: Darj hoga ke aap ne {{name}} ko payment ki
recordedTheyPaid: Darj hoga ke {{name}} ne aap ko payment ki
recordedYouPaidInGroup: {{group}} mein: darj hoga ke aap ne {{name}} ko payment ki
recordedTheyPaidInGroup: {{group}} mein: darj hoga ke {{name}} ne aap ko payment ki
groupWillArchive: Aap aakhri member hain, is liye yeh archive ho jayega
settlingOnlyRecords: Yahan settle karne se sirf yeh darj hota hai ke yeh qarz Tally Stick se bahar ada hue. Koi raqam move nahin hoti. Tamam mutaliqa logon ko itla milti hai aur woh Activity mein record dekhte hain.
leavingGroupsNote: Doosre members Activity mein dekhenge ke aap ne group chhora. Jo group aap aakhir mein chhorein woh archive hota hai, delete nahin hota.
settleAllAndContinue: Sab settle karein aur aage barhein
nothingToSettle: Settle karne ko kuch nahin. Aap ke koi khule balance ya groups nahin hain.
summaryRecordSettlements: Aap ki dekhi hui settlements darj hon gi
summaryLeaveGroups: Aap ke dekhe hue groups chhor diye jayenge
summaryAnonymize: Profile ki pehchaan mita di jayegi. Financial history audit ke liye rahe gi.
deletionConfirmWithPlan: Yeh mustaqil hai. Tally Stick aap ki dekhi hui settlements darj karega, aap ko groups se nikalega, profile ki pehchaan mitayega aur har device se sign out karega.
recordingAndDeleting: Settlements darj ho rahi hain aur aap ka account delete ho raha hai
balancesChangedBody: Aap ke dekhne ke dauran aap ke balance ya groups mein kuch badal gaya. Kuch darj nahin hua aur aap ka account delete nahin hua.
couldntDeleteAccount: Aap ka account delete nahin ho saka
couldntCheckDeletion: Yeh check nahin ho saka ke kya settle karna baqi hai.
accountDeletedBody: Aap ka Tally Stick account delete ho gaya aur har device se sign out ho gaya.
thisSignsOutOnlyThisDevice: Sirf is device se sign out hoga.
receiveTallyStickAlertsOnThisDevice: Is device par Tally Stick alerts paayein.
newAndUpdatedSharedExpenses: Naye aur badle hue mushtarka kharche.
recordedAndUpdatedSettlements: Record kiye aur badle hue settlements.
connectionAndGroupInvitationUpdates: Connection aur group daawat ki updates.
manualRemindersFromPeopleYouOwe: Jin logon ko aap ne dena hai un ke bheje reminders.
couldNotUpdateNotificationSettings: Notification settings update nahin ho sakeen.
theseChooseWhichAlertsPushSendsTheInboxS: Yeh push alerts chunte hain. Inbox mein sab kuch dikhta hai.
disablePushOnThisDevice: Is device par push band karein?
thisStopsPushAlertsOnThisInstallationOth: Is installation par push alerts band ho jayen ge. Doosre devices par asar nahin hoga.
couldNotDisablePushNotifications: Push notifications band nahin ho sakeen.
disablePushOnThisDevice2: Is device par push band karein
pushIsntAvailableInThisVersionOfTallySti: Tally Stick ke is version mein push nahin hai. Har update phir bhi inbox mein aati hai.
yourProfileAndDefaultsAreUpToDate: Aap ki profile aur defaults update hain.
everyoneYouShareALedgerWithSeesThisName: Jin ke saath ledger share karte hain un sab ko yeh naam dikhta hai.
changingYourEmailIsNotSupportedInThisVer: Is version mein email badal nahin sakte.
displayCurrencyChangesTheSymbolTallyStic: Dikhane ki currency sirf Tally Stick mein raqam ka symbol badalti hai. Saved raqam convert nahin hoti. Profile photos nahin hain; naam se initials bante hain.
thatDeviceWillNeedToSignInAgain: Us device par dobara sign in karna hoga.
everyOtherDeviceWillNeedToSignInAgain: Har doosre device par dobara sign in karna hoga.
exportFolder: Profile, social state, financial history, activity, reminders aur notifications ka JSON snapshot save karein. Save karne ke liye folder chunein ge.
exportShare: Profile, social state, financial history, activity, reminders aur notifications ka JSON snapshot save karein. Save ya bhejne ki jagah chunein ge.
turnOnNotificationsBody: Jab koi kharcha add kare, settlement record kare, aapko invite kare ya reminder bheje to alert paayein. Aap ise kabhi bhi Account mein badal sakte hain.
